cues: Now the cold open, done properly.
One per cent ill, a ninety nine per cent catch rate, a two per cent false alarm rate.
Total probability of a positive: point zero two nine seven.
The share from the ill: exactly one third.
That is why a positive screening result is always checked with a second test.
